SELECT
t.*, ( 6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{latitude})) * cos(radians(m.latitude)) * cos(radians(m.longitude) - radians(#{longitude})) + sin(radians(#{latitude})) * sin(radians(m.latitude)) ) ) AS distance, COALESCE(l.like_count, 0) AS likeCount
t.*, COALESCE(l.like_count, 0) AS likeCount
FROM bbs_topic t
LEFT JOIN store_member m ON t.member_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bbs_id, COUNT(*) as like_count FROM bbs_leve WHERE type = 1 AND status = 1 GROUP BY bbs_id ) l ON t.id = l.bbs_id WHERE t.status = 1
AND t.cate_id = #{cateId}
AND t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyWord}, '%')
AND t.member_id = #{memberId}
AND t.member_id IN
#{item}
AND t.id IN
#{item}
ORDER BY distance ASC, l.like_count DESC, t.created_time DESC
ORDER BY l.like_count DESC, t.created_time DESC
